citation.authors: Ho KK, Dervan P, O'Loughlin S, Powell FC
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.finding: The labial melanotic macule is a distinctive benign pigment spot, usually a single lesion on the lower lip, starting around age 30, mostly in women. It can simulate malignant melanoma, and the tissue testing supported its benign nature.
record.note: A pathology series: it is why a single new dark lip spot needs a clinician's look, not a measure of risk.
